claim_scope: exploratory mechanism study; manually designed compatible tasks are not confirmatory held-out evidence

search.semantic_signature: predicate decisions and mapper values on sorted distinct scalar items in training inputs
search.selector: deduplicate finite joint component cells; rank-2W loss quality gate; best-loss anchor; fill by component novelty, loss, minimum signature distance, proposal order, parent rank, and seeded SHA256
search.provider_order_contract: candidates are ordered most to least promising
search.exact_stop: complete the active K-candidate batch, then stop

matched_random_baseline.policy: identical start, feedback-driven hole selection, selector, budget, and stopping rule; replace only LLM proposals with syntax-uniform legal non-no-op repairs without replacement

no_retuning_rule: Do not change prompts, selector, budgets, code, or seeds after seeing any run result. Infrastructure failures are sealed and do not authorize semantic retries.
